groups.title: Tracing Concepts
groups.question: Explain how distributed tracing follows a single request across many services.

followUps.Spans, Traces, and Context Propagation: How does trace context travel from one service to the next, and what happens when teams use different header formats?
followUps.Sampling Strategies: What is the trade-off between head-based and tail-based sampling when you care about rare failures?

groups.title: OpenTelemetry SDK Instrumentation
groups.question: Walk through how you would add tracing to a large set of services using OpenTelemetry.

followUps.Auto-Instrumentation: Why is auto-instrumentation a good first step, and what does it leave out?
followUps.Manual Span Creation and Attributes: Why would you add your own spans and business attributes on top of what auto-instrumentation gives you?

groups.title: Trace Storage Backends
groups.question: Explain the main options for storing traces and what trade-offs they make.

followUps.Jaeger Architecture: Why does it matter that the parts of a Jaeger deployment scale independently when you size it for production?
followUps.Grafana Tempo for Cost-Effective Storage: How does Tempo keep trace storage cheap, and what do you give up compared to an indexed backend?

groups.title: Trace Analysis and Correlation
groups.question: Explain how you turn trace data into answers about performance problems.

followUps.Flame Graphs and Latency Attribution: Why can a view that combines many traces reveal a problem like an N+1 query that a single trace hides?
followUps.Correlating Traces with Logs and Metrics: How do trace IDs in logs and exemplars in histograms let you jump between signals during an investigation?
